source.attribution: Alex W. C. Lee, Jonathan Chung, Marco Lee. GNHK: A Dataset for English Handwriting in the Wild. ICDAR 2021.

selection: Use all four words from the first frozen development page in paperpatch-gnhk-v1, in existing manifest order. No OCR predictions were inspected or used to select these four words.
originalSelection: For each original train/test split and region AF/AS/EU/NA, sort pages by SHA256(paperpatch-gnhk-v1:filename); take first3. Perpage retain type H, regex [A-Za-z][A-Za-z'-]{2,14}; order by SHA256(paperpatch-gnhk-v1:filename:annotationIndex); take first4. No recognition results used to select pages or words.

transport.caveat: Official dataset page now redirects to the Goodnotes homepage. Images and annotations fetched from public mirror claiming unchanged original annotations. Original unavailable archive was not downloaded for byte-level cross-check.

transformations.sourceCrops: Byte-identical copies of the frozen polygon-rectified crops; source photograph is copied unchanged. Original crop transform: order author polygon TL/TR/BR/BL, perspective rectify, add white padding max(4 px, 5% crop height).
transformations.ink: RGB channel excess is R-max(G,B) for red ink or B-max(R,G) for blue ink. Select whichever has the larger 99th percentile. Background is median excess over all crop pixels. Floor is background+6; ceiling is 99th percentile excess. Alpha=clip((excess-floor)/(ceiling-floor),0,1), then set alpha<0.06 to zero. Preserve original RGB pixels. Tight crop to nonzero alpha and add 4 px transparent padding. No morphology, stroke synthesis, drawing, font rendering, letter reconstruction, or OCR-informed operations.
transformations.runtime: Runtime may resize and recolor these pixel alpha masks and place them above generated text with generated strike-through marks; this must be disclosed as a composite.

disclaimer: The handwriting pixels come from a photographed human-written GNHK notebook page. Any review page assembled with them is a composite example, not a photograph of that printed review page. This example is not a representative accuracy benchmark or physical print-pen-phone validation.
